# Rishi Jain | ML Researcher & Engineer

## Professional Summary
ML Researcher and Engineer specializing in Mechanistic Interpretability, Reinforcement Learning, and high-performance language modeling. Passionate about building scalable AI systems and advancing foundational research in neural architectures.

## Core Technical Stack
* **Languages:** Python, Java, JavaScript
* **ML Frameworks:** PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers
* **Infrastructure:** Vercel, Cloudflare, Neon Databases
* **Methodologies:** Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Mechanistic Interpretability, Reinforcement Learning, Transformer Architecture

## Featured Projects

### Hindi-English Translator
An end-to-end Neural Machine Translation system implemented from scratch.
* **Key Features:** Custom RoPE (Rotary Positional Embeddings), Multi-Head Attention (MHA), and optimized beam-search decoding.
* **Tech:** PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers.
* **Link:** [View on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Rishi-Jain-27)

### DebateSearch
An AI-integrated platform for the competitive debate community that aggregates and recommends high-level debate rounds for coaches and researchers.
* **Tech:** JavaScript, SQL, Neon Databases, Vercel, Cloudflare.

### RAG Support Ticket Triage Agent
An intelligent agent designed for automated customer support ticket resolution.
* **Tech:** RAG, Vector Databases, Scikit-learn.
